content.short: Portfel is a comprehensive portfolio tracker for TON, aggregating assets and staking data in one dashboard.
content.description: Portfel is a sophisticated and intuitive portfolio management tool designed specifically for the TON blockchain. It provides users with a comprehensive view of their digital asset holdings, including Jettons, NFTs, and active staking positions across various protocols. Portfel aggregates real-time on-chain data to offer detailed analytics on portfolio performance, historical trends, and reward accumulation. By consolidating complex financial data into a single, user-friendly dashboard, Portfel empowers TON users to manage their decentralized wealth with greater precision and clarity.
content.meta: Track your TON portfolio like a pro with Portfel. Comprehensive asset and staking analytics on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
